# ANTIKRA

> ANTIKRA is a global technology group designing, engineering and operating digital products, technology infrastructure and companies for complex environments. Its operating base is Kampala, Uganda, and it serves organizations internationally.

ANTIKRA combines six specialist companies as one coordinated technology system:

- [Mechanism](https://antikra.com/companies/mechanism): product engineering and software systems.
- [Cosmos](https://antikra.com/companies/cosmos): cloud infrastructure, platforms and operations.
- [Orrery](https://antikra.com/companies/orrery): artificial intelligence, data engineering and analytics.
- [Astra](https://antikra.com/companies/astra): cybersecurity across applications, infrastructure and data.
- [Helios](https://antikra.com/companies/helios): experience design, product design and design systems.
- [Olympia](https://antikra.com/companies/olympia): technology venture building.

## Products

- [Rembeh](https://antikra.com/products/rembeh): financial operations infrastructure for lending businesses.
- [Carmie](https://antikra.com/products/carmie): infrastructure for the automotive service economy.
